pages.text: The blast furnace only works while it receives $(item)hot air$(). Making it takes three machines:

$(li)An $(item)air intake$() turns rotation into $(item)air$().$(li)A $(item)blast stove$() burns a fuel to heat that air into $(item)hot air$(). Its fuel is $(item)creosote$() (from the coke oven) or $(item)furnace gas$() (from the blast furnace itself).$(li)An $(item)exhaust$() or a $(item)smokestack$() gets rid of the $(item)CO2$() the stove gives off.
$(l)The recipe$()$(br)Each share of the stove recipe takes $(item)25 mB air$() and $(item)5 mB fuel$(), and gives $(item)25 mB hot air$() and $(item)25 mB CO2$().

Hot air then goes through pipes into a $(item)blast furnace hatch$() set in the furnace wall. Build this line before the furnace: start the stove on creosote, and once the furnace runs you can feed the stove with the furnace gas it collects.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
